text.text: Learners, lessons, cars and road tests in one place. Start with the Dashboard each morning. Book every lesson with a car and an instructor, mark it done or no-show the same day, and send a car to the shop the moment a service is overdue.

text.text: The first lesson sets the learner's confidence. Choose a quiet place, go slowly and finish on a win.
Check the permit and photo ID

Start in an empty lot: start, stop, steer, turn.
Name every action before the learner does it.
Stop for a short debrief before leaving.
Mark the lesson done and record the hours
Tick the skills covered on the learner's checklist
Book the next lesson before the learner leaves
Test day should feel like another lesson. Rehearse the route and the paperwork.
Press Mark test ready only when the learner has met the checklist twice in a row.
Book a practice lesson on the test route.
Send a reminder with documents to bring.
Arrive early and do a calm warm-up drive.
Check the car's lights, signals and insurance papers.
After the test, press Mark passed or Mark failed and add a note for the next lesson.
